IS 15908 : 2021 Selection, Installation and Maintenance of Control and Indicating Equipment for Fire Detection and Alarm System-Code of Practice
ICS 13.220.20
CED 22
Revised Standard from Last Update.1 SCOPE1.1 This standard covers planning, design, maintenance and performance criteria for control and indicating equipment for fire detection and alarm systems.1.2 This standard covers minimum level of protection. Nothing in this standard prevents to install systems designed for higher degree of protection, for special risks, etc.2 REFERENCESThe standards listed at Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision, and parties to agreements based on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of the standards.
